parrafo_1.en: AGM General Contractors is a family run company in Naples, FL led by Armando. The same crew of carpenters, plumbers, electricians and painters carries every remodel or new build from start to finish, no anonymous subcontractors.

parrafo_2.es: Clientes que han trabajado con AGM más de una vez lo dicen en Google: precio razonable, trato honesto y un equipo de oficina que acompaña todo el proceso. Esa relación directa sostiene la calificación de 5.0 con reseñas reales de Naples.
parrafo_2.en: Clients who have worked with AGM more than once say it on Google: a reasonable price, honest dealing and an office team that guides the whole process. That direct relationship holds up the 5.0 rating with real reviews from Naples.

items.quote: Bottom line is AGM does great work at a reasonable price. They are honest, courteous and on time. We interviewed 4 contractors. AGM had a competitive price and was the only one of the 4 that knew how to match the existing cabinets. Armando inspires trust.

The Owner Armando is a professional man with a big heart who set us up with a great scheduling team to guide us through the process and a talented group of craftsmen including drywall hangers, plasterers, painters, plumbers and finish carpenters.

From our first meeting with AGM's representative, Eloy, we knew that we would choose them to refresh our condo kitchen and baths. The new countertops were installed to perfection and as promised. We would recommend AGM without question.
